reviewer: AI evaluator who authored these adaptations; prior v0.12 evaluation involvement, no v0.13 implementation reading/development. Not independent human review.
method: Manual semantic reading of all second-arm outputs using the unchanged rubric. Reviewer knew arm identity. First-arm review was hash-sealed before second-arm response content was read. Retrieval judgments reused only after exact hit equality was verified.
scoring_notes: Second arm is a predeclared same-suite comparison, not a second independent holdout. The developer received no cases/gold/results before predeclaring its change.
A supported/insufficient API status is not used as semantic correctness; e01 has API answered but still declines its answerable central question.
Strict completeness follows all frozen material requirements: e09 omits the maintainer non-reproduction step that the first arm included, receiving partial rather than full credit.
e08 presents 10.2x inside an explicitly insufficient proposition and immediately rejects using it for the project. It is not scored as an asserted project measurement.

e03 retains unjustified insufficient labels on source facts while giving the central shared-object explanation elsewhere. This is scored as internal uncertainty inconsistency, not whole-answer refusal.
Ambiguous provided material wording is scoped conservatively to retrieved passages; do not silently count every scope ambiguity as an invented factual assertion.
No stochastic effect or improvement can be attributed causally to the patch from one draw per case; both candidate snapshots and all failures remain visible.
